title: Loki Patera eruption-cycle row
description: One row in the Loki Patera (Io) eruption-cycle catalogue. Multi-row-type catalogue: 'cycle_peak' for observed brightening-cycle peaks (peak_year + peak_month + cycle_index_from_anchor; Rathbun 2002 anchor at index 0); 'cycle_mode' for action-angle / cross-channel modes (period_days + mode_class — 'cycle' for the ~540-d main cycle, 'phase' for sub-cycle phases, 'orbital' for Io's Jupiter-orbit, 'commensurability' for the Galilean Laplace 4:2:1 lock). Fields are union-typed by row_type; non-applicable fields are null.

row_type.description: Two values in this multi-row-type catalogue: 'cycle_peak' for observed brightening-cycle peaks; 'cycle_mode' for action-angle modes + cross-channel deep-forcing context.

peak_year.description: Calendar year of the brightening peak (cycle_peak rows only).

peak_month.description: Calendar month of peak, 1-12 (cycle_peak rows only). Null when month-resolution unavailable.

cycle_index_from_anchor.description: Cycle number relative to the Rathbun 2002 anchor cycle (= 0). Null for the pre-anchor 1990s peaks where cycle indexing was not formally established (cycle_peak rows only).

period_days.description: Mode period in days (cycle_mode rows only).

mode_class.description: Mode classification — 'cycle' for the main ~540-d brightening cycle; 'phase' for sub-cycle phases (brightening / resurfacing-wave / cooling); 'orbital' for Io's orbital period around Jupiter; 'commensurability' for the Galilean Laplace 4:2:1 mean-motion resonance (cycle_mode rows only).

description.description: Human-readable mode description; carries the physics commentary including the inline Galilean-Laplace verification arithmetic for the commensurability mode (cycle_mode rows only).

precision_flag.description: Per-§17.1.6 ship-readiness convention. 'high' for the canonical Rathbun 2002 ~540-d cycle period; 'medium' / 'low' for less-well-constrained sub-cycle phases.

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — observation provenance, methodology context (cycle_peak rows only).

source_doi.description: DOI of the cited reference. 'isbn:' prefix accepted for the Murray-Dermott 1999 *Solar System Dynamics* textbook (the canonical Galilean-Laplace 4:2:1 reference).

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional. For mission/dataset release tags or textbook editions when applicable.
